content: Gote-na agaa onaa lakelaina

Gore Yesu Krais-me pa piri onaanu-para aba ome onaanu-para rayo yoto epa rumaalia-daa neme Gote-na ini agaa madaa ne agaa puri paloa gupa lagialo: Yesu Krais-re go su amaa ipua niaa oro yaalo surubalia-pulu go mada agaa mana lagialo:

Neme nipuna agaa onaanu waru lakelape. Goa pua ora yapi di rayo madaare oro yaalo puri paloa waru lakelape. Goa pua pawasi pua agaa waru lakelape. Goa pua nimuna kone maepeaaina ora puri pane agaa lakelape. Goa pua nimuna kone maredepo yaana lakelape. Go page nimuna robaa-para puri mapalainalo lakelape.

Goa pea pare oropere epaliade yapi di rabu onaanumi ora agaa ria napagalimi. Go rabu nimuna pu robaa ru-nane i kone madaa raaname omolalo nimuna tisaa rado radonu mea kiritalimi. Goa pua mo tisaanumi nimuna raaname ome agaa lakenalo rado rado mea kiritaa-mama palimi.
Goa puare nimumi ora agaa pagapere gimoa nimumi pa remaanu pagolalore nimuna lo robaa marekeaawa piralimi.
Goa pea-ga oro yaalo nena kone waru suruboa pora waru kurua pope. Goa pua kedaanu rua neme Epe Agaa lakelape kogono waru pua Gote-na gisade kogonore waru pu kiritape.
Pol-na kogonore go dia yala
Gore abia Gote-na miru iritalo repename waini ipa mea koyaaeme-rupa nina yaapi koyalimi rabu re-para omalalo pi. Abia nina kogono madaare nina omape di rudu yala.
Gore aanu epe agirali aloma pemede-rupare neme pora rayo pamuaware Gote-na gisade epe kone rulae agaa riare neme waru surubede.

Goa pea-ga epe-rupa aipapulu epeme onaana yotore aba managola saabaaya. Go epe yotore mo epe koso pagape Aa Mudumi nina aalu madaa epe raguna-rupa mea adi palia. Go aa epaliade yapi di raburi nipumi ni go epe yae gialia pare ni padane nagialia. Dia, pare onaa rayome nipuna epape di madaa raaname omoa suruba pimi onaanu page katea.
Agaa lo madiaaya patalepape ne agaa
Gore ni piri-para aipapulu epaina kalai pape.
Paga, Demas-me niri aba gimoa su amaa yae ratulalo raaname omesa. Gore nipumi ni gimoa Tesalonaika su-para pisa. Kresens nipuri Galesia su-para pisa Taitus-ri Dalmesia su-nane pisa.
Goa pua Luk padanere ni raapu pa pipa. Gore neme Mak pua lamu mua mea epape. Nipuri nina kogono madaa ni epe-rupa raba mealia.
Neme Tikikus aba Efesus su-para mea rapaasu.
Gore ne epolalo pali-daare nina saket mo Karpus nipu kasu-ga Troas su-para ia-ga neme ora pua meatepape. Go page buk mea epali rabu mo hos yoganeme warini buk-ri neme tisu-ga ora mea epape.
Aleksander nipu oyaenu aana bras-me kunua warini aamere nipumi abade ni-para ora waea pamu pisa. Gore orope nipuna mo waea pisa madaare Aa Mudumi ora wae yoto katea.
Neme page go aa waru adape. Nipumi abade niaana agaa rabuaniaatalo agu pisa-ga.
Aba ripiare neme koso lape agaa sude raburi aa meda ni raba mulalo napirisa. Dia go raburi aa rayome ni gimisimi. Yapare neme nimu wae yoto naminalo Gote-para beten laayo.

Goa pisimi rabu Aa Mudumi abade ni raapu pirua ni puri gisa. Go rabu neme mo ruru rado piri onaanu rayo epe agaa pagenalo pamu lakesude. Go rabu iaanumi ora wae yana-rupa pirua ni nolalo pisimi. Goa pisimi pare Gote-me ni raba misade.

Go-rupa madaare aanumi ni waea pulalo peme pare Aa Mudumi ni raba mealia. Goa puare nipumi ni nipuna so yaa-para Surube Su adanolo epe-rupa mea palia. Goa pea-ga oro yaalo Aa Mudu-na bi minasaamina. Go ora.
Nemere Prisila-para Akwila repaaya-para epe-rupa piralepa lo wai lo repaato. Go page Onesiforus-repaa page epe-rupa piranalo wai lo repaato.
Erastus nipuri Korin su-para pa pirisa. Goa pisa pare Trofimus yaina omesa-pulu mo Miletus su-para aina ipisude.
Gore upame omoa po ripu epape dinu epalia-ga neme ni piri-para aipapulu abi epape. Yubulus-para, Pudens-para, Linus-para, Klodia-para go nena amenu rayo page epe-rupa piralepape agaa lo o taatema.
Aa Muduri nena kone raapu piralia. Goa pua nimi rayome Gote-na epe raba meape kone kuma pi mealimina. Go mada. Ni Pol yaade.
